title: Restlessness brought into company
subtitle: A short return when motion is pretending to guide you
description: A brief path that stops the wandering mind long enough to find mercy, saintly company, and a truer place to dwell.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The mind’s wanderings cease where the Society of the Saints becomes home.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Restlessness needs better placement before it needs more options.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle treats motion as a sign that the heart needs holy company, not more stimulation.
evidence.turn: The search begins to rest when it is placed near sangat and Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Stop adding choices; move toward one practice or person that quiets the wandering.
